```{r, echo=FALSE}
#| label: Pull_QCL_data

#Pull data on world food staples, topics of interest
#maize, wheat, rice
#milk/dairy?, eggs, chicken/pork, beef, 

# shrimp may be one of the global food reliance difference between production and consumption
#what is the food for shrimp?
# - Soybean meal for shrimp; fishmeal
#Insects for food and feed

# 2. Define the historical timeline (1961 to 2024)
all_years <- 1961:2024

# 3. Create a paced API function that automatically pauses for 1.5 seconds every time it runs
fetch_single_year_paced <- slowly(
  \(single_year) {
    cat(paste("Streaming All Countries for Year:", single_year, "\n"))
    
    # Send the authenticated developer API request
    req_perform(
      request("https://faostatservices.fao.org/api/v1") |>
        req_headers("Authorization" = paste("Bearer", get_faostat_headers()["Authorization"])) |>
        req_body_json(list(
          domain  = "QCL",               # Crops Production Domain
          area    = "all",               # Pulls ALL countries simultaneously
          item    = c("15", "27", "56"), # 15 = Wheat, 27 = Rice, 56 = Maize
          element = "5510",              # 5510 = Production Quantity (Tonnes)
          year    = as.character(single_year) # Sliced year-by-year
        ))
    ) |>
    resp_body_string() |>
    fromJSON() |>
    as.data.frame()
  },
  # This sets your exact pause timer rate (1.5 seconds per loop)
  rate = rate_delay(pause = 1.5)
)

# 4. Map your paced function across all years and stack them into a master table
staples_production <- all_years |>
  map(fetch_single_year_paced) |>
  list_rbind()

# 5. View your safely gathered timeline table
head(staples_production)
```



```{r, eval=FALSE}

#Build the live REST request for Crops Production (QCL)

prod_request <- request("https://faostatservices.fao.org/api/v1") |>
  req_headers(
    # Safely passes your token as a header string invisibly
    "Authorization" = paste("Bearer", get_faostat_headers()["Authorization"])
  ) |>
  req_body_json(list(
    domain  = "QCL",               # Crops Production Domain
    area    = "all",               # ALL countries globally
    year    = "all",               # ALL historical years
    item    = c("15", "27", "56"), # 15=Wheat, 27=Rice, 56=Maize
    element = "5510"               # 5510=Production Quantity (Tonnes)
  ))

# 3. Perform the live authenticated call (Will NEVER prompt your console!)
prod_response <- req_perform(prod_request)

# 4. Convert the incoming raw server data directly into a clean R table
staples_production <- resp_body_string(prod_response) |> 
  fromJSON() |> 
  as.data.frame()

# View your live global dataset safely
head(staples_production)



```
